sensitive_flag.rule: Damaging or critical coverage of G42, its leadership, Inception42 or its executives is never written into the brief. It is listed in this file with outlet, headline, link and a one-line note so the comms team can decide what to share.

dashboard.note: Morning Brief Operations dashboard (private claude.ai artifact). The run reads settings/main at Stage 0 and writes runs/<edition id> and issues/* at Stage 6 through the ArtifactData tool. Environment variables take precedence over keys stored there.
